title: The Stones Are Dimming
_comment: Region 1 main quest, Acts I-V (story v2, the emotional rollercoaster: docs/regions/EMOTION_MAP_R1.md). Schema: data/region1/quests/README.md. Runtime: scripts/region1/story_quest.gd. Lint: tools_qa/region1/lint_quests.gd. 'staging' is direction for C7/C9/C12/Codex (intensity -5..+5, music cue from the registry, camera, anim, vfx, silence, weather, time, needs). Ids are save data: never rename a step, objective or flag once shipped.

steps.title: A Stone Goes Dark
steps.objective: Hear what happened to the Miller's Stone
steps.journal: Captain Hollis came to supper with honey cakes. Then the Miller's Stone went out. Mother wants me indoors.

staging.camera: low table-height shot of supper; cut to the window as the stone's glow dies on the glass
staging.vfx: stone glow fades out over 2 s

steps.title: Hold the Lantern
steps.objective: Help Warden Idra relight the stone
steps.journal: Idra says my hands are quicker than hers. Down, across, up. Don't lift.

staging.camera: over-the-shoulder on the stone face; push in on the child's finger
staging.anim: kneel-and-trace loop; Idra's slow, shaking hand beside yours (X2)
staging.vfx: glowing stroke trail, stone flares warm gold, r1_ward_activate
staging.silence: no music for the first stroke

steps.title: Whose Light
steps.objective: Ask Idra who lit the stone
steps.journal: Old Hesk the miller rests in the stone. The stubborn part of him. Stubborn lasts.

staging.emotion: tenderness, then a prickle of fear
staging.sfx: r1_rune_hum swells when Hesk is named; a wolf howl far off at the end

steps.title: Something at the Ring Edge
steps.objective: Drive off the wolf at the ring edge
steps.journal: A wolf had a stagborn fawn pinned in the brambles. I got between them. A one-armed woman shouted at my feet.

staging.emotion: fear, then a first small triumph
staging.camera: low, child's-eye; the wolf's silhouette against the ring glow
staging.anim: fawn struggles in brambles; Maren vaults the fence one-handed (X4 sparring set)

steps.title: A Fawn Named Thistle
steps.objective: Free the fawn and bring it home
steps.journal: The fawn followed me home. Mother said it's not sleeping in the house. Father said it's sleeping in the house. Its name is Thistle.

staging.camera: the fawn's antler-buds glowing blue in close-up; then a wide of the house door, parents arguing, fawn already inside
staging.anim: fawn follow-and-nuzzle loop; mother hands-on-hips (Codex: critter follow)
staging.vfx: faint blue glow on the antler-buds

steps.title: Both Arms While You Have Them
steps.objective: Train with Maren at the Staff Yard
steps.journal: Maren Coldbrook held a stone lit with her own warmth once. It cost her an arm. Her niece Wren knocked me flat twice.

staging.anim: staff drills; Wren's cheeky sweep; Maren one-armed demo (Codex)

steps.title: Lanterns for the Dead
steps.objective: Hang a lantern at the ring on Kindling Night
steps.journal: Kindling Night. A lantern for everyone who rests in a stone. The Captain hung his last, for friends up north. Thistle ate one.

staging.emotion: belonging, the warmest night of childhood
staging.camera: slow crane up the ring as paper lanterns rise to the stones; the whole cast in one frame
staging.anim: lantern hang; father lifts you onto his shoulders; Thistle chews paper
staging.vfx: paper lanterns, warm bloom, embers drifting

steps.title: The Eve of Twelve
steps.objective: Grow up (Blessing at age 12)
steps.journal: Years pass. Tomorrow the ring asks what I am. Idra says: let it answer me.

steps.title: The Blessing
steps.objective: Stand in the ring for your Blessing
steps.journal: The ring answered. Every stone lit at once.

staging.camera: see the C9 blessing shot list; hold on Idra at the edge, sitting down hard (the twist's seed)
staging.vfx: element motes; Vale-wide stone flare
staging.silence: one beat of silence before the stones light

steps.title: A Throat Cleared
steps.objective: Speak with Idra after the ceremony
steps.journal: Every stone in the Vale flared tonight. Idra called me apprentice. Wren says I'm insufferable now.

staging.sfx: r1_rune_hum drops a semitone on 'bad news'

steps.title: Three Letters
steps.objective: Choose an apprenticeship
steps.journal: The Guild, Highwatch or the Runeward. Whatever I choose, Idra still wants me on the roads.

steps.title: Forty-One Stones
steps.objective: Relight 2 stones on the Greenhollow road
steps.journal: Nine guards, forty-one stones, sixty miles of road. Captain Hollis did the sum for me, and asked me to report every stone.

staging.camera: hold one beat on Bram's ledger as he writes your stones down

steps.title: The Herd on the Old Line
steps.objective: Watch the Stagborn cross at dawn
steps.journal: At dawn the Stagborn walked the old ward-line past us, antlers blue. Thistle heard them. I had to choose.

staging.camera: C9 herd_crossing: mist, the herd in silhouette walking the faint ward-line; Thistle's ears turn
staging.anim: Stagborn herd walk and bellow (X3); Thistle hesitates between you and the herd
staging.vfx: ward-line lights under each hoof, blue antler glow

steps.title: Ten Years of Barn
steps.objective: Go to the burned farm at Greenhollow
steps.journal: Boars with purple eyes came through a gap in the ward. The Captain's patrol checked that stone last week.

staging.camera: walk-in through smoke; the barn frame still smouldering
staging.vfx: smoke, embers, charred ground decal

steps.title: What the Ash Saw
steps.objective: Read the ash by the broken stone
steps.journal: Fire remembers. A hooded figure cut the glyph out clean. Someone else watched with a shuttered lantern.

staging.emotion: eerie wonder, a question with no face
staging.camera: desaturate to grey; ghosts replay; slow pan to the watcher at frame edge, face never shown
staging.vfx: grey ghost shader, ember trail north-east

steps.title: The Ashen Hand
steps.objective: Follow the ember trail into Duskbriar
steps.journal: The saboteur was a boy called Corin. They pay him in purple glass from the Edge, and someone hands them a list.

staging.camera: after the fight, Corin cornered, shot from above: he is small

steps.title: A Thief Who Tells the Truth
steps.objective: Tell Idra what Corin said
steps.journal: The stones are dying on their own. That frightens Idra more than any liar. Her lantern dimmed when she coughed.

staging.vfx: Idra's lantern dims while she coughs (the twist's second seed)

steps.title: Section Four
steps.objective: Earn a carving licence in Silverford
steps.journal: Guildmaster Thale's ledgers: repairs triple every year, and none of them hold. The stones are empty.

steps.title: Pay the Lamp-Lighter
steps.objective: Visit the Solkar caravan at Silverford market
steps.journal: Imra Solvane of Solkar says fire takes the purple back. Slowly. Patiently.

steps.title: The Council of Wardens
steps.objective: Stand with Idra before the King
steps.journal: The Dawn Throne offers relics that shine without anyone's dead inside. The King asked me what to do.

staging.emotion: weight, a child in a room of power
staging.camera: low angle up at the throne; the player small in a long hall

steps.title: The Violet Line
steps.objective: Stop the Scar at Greenhollow's fields
steps.journal: The ground is moving. Burn it back, or fill a pack with crystal: the valley is watching which.

staging.emotion: dread of something alive and spreading
staging.camera: wide: the violet edge visibly creeping across a wheat field
staging.vfx: scar overlay creep, crystal glints, fire burn-back

steps.title: The Fallen Heart
steps.objective: Follow the fleeing Stagborn to their Glade
steps.journal: The Elder Stones are the Vale's five hearts, and their embers are two hundred years old. Nobody gives any more.

staging.camera: reveal the tilted, cold Elder Stone through ferns; no birds
staging.silence: birdsong cuts out as you enter
staging.vfx: cold stone: frost rime, no glow

steps.title: Grey Fingers
steps.objective: Read the ash at the Miller's Stone
steps.journal: Idra has been feeding the Miller's Stone with her own warmth for thirty years. Her slow hands. Her grey fingers. I never asked.

staging.emotion: the gut-punch twist: a mentor dying on purpose
staging.camera: Ashsight replays Act I from a new angle: the same stone, the same night, now showing Idra's hand shaking
staging.anim: Idra collapses (unique, Codex); carry-her pose; ghost Idra palm-on-stone loop
staging.vfx: ghost replay re-uses the Act I carve moment; a thin gold thread from Idra's chest into the stone
staging.silence: the Act I rune hum plays alone, then stops

steps.title: The Last Good Night
steps.objective: Come home for Kindling Night
steps.journal: Ashford lit Kindling early, for Idra. Father and Maren fought with staves. Thistle ate a lantern again. The Guard had gone to Greenhollow.

staging.camera: mirror the Act I Kindling crane shot exactly; one more lantern (Idra's), one fewer guard
staging.anim: father vs Maren staff bout (comic), dancing crowd
staging.vfx: lanterns, bloom

steps.title: Staff Up
steps.objective: Hold the ring while Maren holds the stone
steps.journal: The ring went dark mid-song. Maren held the heart-stone lit by hand. Her ember stayed. The ring burns gold now.

staging.camera: handheld during the fight; C9 maren_last_stand: Maren kneeling, one palm on the heart-stone, silhouetted
staging.anim: Maren one-armed stone-hold (unique, Codex); lanterns falling; child villagers fleeing
staging.vfx: every lantern and stone snuffs at once, r1_ward_break; then gold ember rising and sinking into the stone
staging.silence: hard cut to silence when the ring goes dark; music returns only when her ember sinks

steps.title: The Ledger
steps.objective: Read the ash where the ring line was cut
steps.journal: The ash showed a Guard's key and a voice counting. Captain Hollis sold my reports to the Hand. One dark night, he said.

staging.emotion: betrayal, and your own guilt in it
staging.camera: Ashsight: the watcher from the Pennick farm turns; this time the lantern lifts to his face
staging.anim: Bram seated on the guardhouse step, not standing up (unique idle, Codex)
staging.vfx: ghost replay of the pin being pulled; ledger pages in the ash

steps.title: The Longest Night
steps.objective: Keep vigil at the ring
steps.journal: Wren walked away in the rain. I knelt at the heart-stone, and Maren told me to block with the wood, not my face.

staging.emotion: dark night of the soul, then one spark
staging.camera: static wide, player tiny in the rain by the gold stone; slow push-in only when Maren speaks
staging.anim: kneel in rain, head down; stand-up with the staff (unique, Codex)
staging.vfx: rain, gold rune glow pulsing with Maren's words
staging.silence: rain only until Maren's first line

steps.title: The Antlered Warden
steps.objective: Pass the Warden's trial and relight the Glade
steps.journal: Wren came back. Tire it, don't kill it. Then carve Bless while it watches. It bowed its antlers to the stone.

staging.camera: after the fight: the Warden and Thistle framed together before the stone
staging.anim: Warden 3-phase moveset and bow (X3); Thistle grown (freed) or fawn-sized (kept)
staging.vfx: blue light running down the antlers

steps.title: Rock Does Not Read
steps.objective: Burn the rift seam and relight Greyseam
steps.journal: Tuskridge orcs dig the deep seam to feed their children. The purple came up out of the rock.

staging.vfx: miners' lamps relight in a chain down the shaft

steps.title: Without the Knees
steps.objective: Hold Highwatch's gate with Sir Rowan
steps.journal: Seventy winters. Rowan asked me to carry his ember and put it where it does the most good.

staging.emotion: a good man's death, chosen and gentle
staging.camera: C9 rowan_ember: Rowan against the battlement, smiling at the wind
staging.anim: wounded sit-down against the wall; hand-hold (Codex)
staging.vfx: ember rises; wind-driven snow stops mid-air
staging.silence: the wind stops when he dies

steps.title: A Leash of Light
steps.objective: Read the ash at Crownstead and reroute its line
steps.journal: Under the cart and the Edge woman's voice, older ash: a young Bram Hollis pulling the line to Hollin's Reach. She is his sister.

staging.emotion: understanding the enemy: grief, not malice
staging.camera: Ashsight in two layers: fresh grey ghosts, then older, browner ghosts beneath them
staging.vfx: second, sepia-tinted ghost layer for old ash (L11 variant)

steps.title: Child of the Ford
steps.objective: Recover the keystone and wake the Elden stone
steps.journal: Snikkit borrowed the keystone because it was lonely. The stone on the Elden Road knew my name.

staging.vfx: ancestor face in the stone glow

steps.title: Five Hearts Beating
steps.objective: Route 3 ward-lines toward the Edge
steps.journal: The whole Vale hums like a hive. We'll want every spark at the Rift mouth.

staging.camera: map layer: five hearts pulsing in sync; lines racing east
staging.vfx: ward map pulse

steps.title: Edge Rules
steps.objective: Confront the quartermaster at Rift's Edge
steps.journal: Tamsin Reeve paid for the cut stones. Her brother pulled the line from her village. Forty graves, one winter.

staging.camera: two-shot across a supply table; she never stands

steps.title: Walk It Home
steps.objective: Push the Scar back to the Rift mouth
steps.journal: Burn and ward, cell by cell. Everyone I ever helped came over that ridge.

staging.emotion: every callback pays off at once
staging.camera: ridge reveal per ally (Tuskridge, goblins, herd, Corin, Bram), each a 2 s hero shot
staging.anim: ally arrival set pieces (Codex: horn blow, goblin point-and-shriek, herd charge)
staging.vfx: burn-back fronts, ward-line bubbles pushing violet back

steps.title: It Was a Troll, Once
steps.objective: Defeat the Scarbound Troll
steps.journal: Stone skin. Crystal spine. Whatever it was, the Scar finished it. Wren took the left.

staging.camera: X6 boss intro: rise from the violet, low angle
staging.vfx: crystal hazards, violet storm

steps.title: All of Them
steps.objective: Close the Rift mouth
steps.journal: The mouth wanted an ember. Idra offered hers. What I had given along the way decided who else paid.

staging.emotion: sacrifice and catharsis; who pays is the player's doing
staging.camera: C9 finale_seal, variant per ending (idra, bram, tamsin, kindled)
staging.anim: walk-into-the-light (unique per sacrificer, Codex); the Stagborn herd charge (kindled)
staging.vfx: ember-figures converging along ward-lines; the mouth shrinking; the Rift glimpse
staging.silence: all sound drops as the mouth closes; birdsong returns

steps.title: Homecoming
steps.objective: Go home to Ashford
steps.journal: Kindling Night, a year on. New lanterns at the ring. The heart-stone told me: not bad, not good, not bad.

staging.camera: C9 region_complete: golden-hour walk, then the Kindling lanterns, mirroring Act I
staging.vfx: lanterns; the heart-stone's gold hum
